messages:
Maya: Half-time wings run tonight? Game starts at 8:20 but if we do halftime it'll be ~9:30. Who's in?
Jordan: I'm down for wings. Any spot that does gluten-free?
Priya: Count me in — I'm on fantasy waiver free so I might swap a bench guy right before lock.
Sam: FYI my lineup is a dumpster fire, sending a trade offer in 5. :sweat_smile:
Maya: Also quick poll: who thinks the mascot will do the flip during halftime? (last year's flip guy retired)
Jordan: No way. Mascots have retired flips. I vote no. :thinking_face:
Priya: Heck yes. If he does it, lunchbot owes us stickers. @lunchbot can we make that a bet?
lunchbot: automated reminder: sign up for group orders via https://order.example.com — please include dietary notes.
Sam: If we order, can we do mix: buffalo, garlic parm, and vegan cauliflower?
Maya: Yep. I'll put an order sheet in the thread. Vote with emoji: :hot_pepper: buffalo, :garlic: parm, :leafy_green: vegan.
Jordan: :hot_pepper:
Priya: :leafy_green:
Sam: :garlic:
Maya: Also, fantasy heads-up — I'll swap my kicker for a FLEX if it opens. DM me if you want to pounce.
Jordan: On mascot flips, I'll take a 20-coin side bet. @Priya you in?
Priya: I will match 10 coin. If mascot flips, I bring celebratory donuts to the office tomorrow. If not, I'll buy coffee for the snack table. Deal?
Maya: Deal. My money is on no flip but the donuts would be awesome. :crossed_fingers:
Sam: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/mascot-fail-3o6ZsYk (paste)
Maya: OK final logistics: meet in the kitchen at 9:25, I’ll text once wings arrive. See y'all there.
